text.p: These are the leading stories in the Mauritius press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Opposition Mouvement Militant Mauricien (MMM) party considers a walk out of the parliament on Monday if a vote is taken on a bill to provide a legal framework for projects under concession agreements within the privatisation process.
- The Prime Minister of Mauritius and leader of the ruling Labour Party Navin Ramgoolam says his party will be in power beyond the year 2000.
